ios.desc:
Hypertrophy is a thoughtful app for tracking your workouts. Think of it as your Notes app for the gym.

I built it from the beginning to look and feel immediately familiar as an iOS app, so it covers the basics and does it well. Hypertrophy was designed for bodybuilding and powerlifting, and is also suitable for general gym goers or home workouts.

Completely free to use. No ads. No sign up required. No paywalls. No unnecessary AI.

FEATURES
- View and edit your past workouts
- Automatically synced with iCloud
- Unlimited custom exercises
- Rest timers with support for Live Activities and Dynamic Island
- Import from Strong
- Native iOS keyboard for weight and rep entry
- Charts for weekly sets per muscle group
- Apple Health integration
- Support for Metric (kg) and Imperial (lb) units
- Comprehensive built-in exercise library
- Dark mode support

quotes.text:
I've been building Hypertrophy, an iOS-native workout app. I've always wanted a simpler, cleaner experience than Strong (on which I've done over 1000 workouts) so I built my own.

I've tried to make it look and feel at home in iOS and I like to think of it as a Notes app for the gym—it does very few things and does them well.

It's completely free with no ads because I'm not a fan of how other workout apps charge you for a basic workout experience.

I've just finished up the Import from Strong feature and would love any feedback on it!
